notes: Representative sample: reserve one meeting for every governed theme that occurs, then allocate the remaining seats by the largest-remainder method on (count - 1). Within a theme, seats are split across support, external, and internal by the same method. Meetings inside a stratum are drawn with random.Random seeded by 7, the theme, and the call type. Inclusion probability is stratum seats divided by stratum size. Challenging cases are every meeting already on the review queue. That list is not a probability sample and is scored on its own.

These meetings were queued because the theme margin was thin or the held-out topic shared no words with the supplied labels. Accuracy here is not the accuracy of a random meeting. Do not average it with the representative sample.
